label: rem:kashaev-as-archimedean-realization
title: Kashaev limit as the archimedean realization functor
html:
Remark. Kashaev limit as the archimedean realization functor

The Kashaev volume conjecture identifies the archimedean realization functor applied to the algebraic quantum volume. It is the canonical action of \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{top}} on the brane substrate.

Algebraic side. The colored Jones polynomial evaluated at roots of unity is a purely p-adic/cyclotomic discrete algebraic trace. The algebraic quantum volume \mathrm{Vol}_q(\mathcal{B}_K) packages these local data into a global Habiro element.

Archimedean realization. The asymptotic limit N \to \infty executes the action of \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} = \pi_\infty \circ \tau. It discards cyclotomic data and projects the adelic ring to \mathbb{R}. The Kashaev-Murakami-Murakami theorem confirms this limit equals the hyperbolic volume:

  \mathrm{Vol}(S^3 \setminus K)
  \;=\;
  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\mathcal{B}_K)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{top}}\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\mathcal{B}_K)\bigr).

The fibre functor \tau is the exclusive archimedean route.
